description: The machine the STARlet's USB cable is plugged into (macOS never enumerates the STAR), reached over SSH by pipeline/remote.py. host is an SSH host (an alias from ~/.ssh/config works); dir, python and star_lock are relative to the remote home folder. star_lock is the lock file the AHC bridge uses, so the two never drive the instrument at the same time.
name: Raspberry Pi
